title: Petra and the Parish
author: Emrys Kavanagh
blurb: Vesper Ishikawa, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
